svg.text: Diagram D: File Upload and Async Processing Pipeline
UPDATE file status=processing; UPDATE job status=running
Convert to COG / tile pyramid, store output
Validate JWT + check role (SE or Admin)
- Unsupported file type / bad MIME: 400 INVALID_FILE_TYPE
- Duplicate checksum found: 200, linked to existing file,
- Retry on a job that is not failed: 400 INVALID_STATE
- Retry count exceeds configured max: 429 RETRY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
- Files Module streams bytes directly to Object Storage;
raw bytes never touch the database or app memory
- Processing Module is the only module that mutates file
and job status once upload is accepted
- Redis holds ephemeral job/session state; PostgreSQL
- Audit Module is called synchronously on completion
- Message Broker publish is fire-and-forget, consumed by
other Hitech services outside this boundary
- Dashed orange box: Drone Mapping Service boundary
- Colored modules inside the box are internal
- Object Storage and Message Broker are external systems
